constituentArticles.title: Health Ministry launches National Mass Drug Administration Campaign for Lymphatic Filariasis
constituentArticles.text: JP Nadda launched campaign in 348 endemic districts across 20 states to eliminate LF (elephantiasis) by end-2027 (ahead of SDG 2030).
